async function more(i) {
	return i < 3;
}
async function save(i) {}

// CASE js_single_cond_empty expect=fire
async function e1() {
	for (let i = 0; await more(i); i++);
}

// CASE js_multi_cond_empty expect=fire
async function e2() {
	for (let i = 0, j = 1; await more(i + j); i++);
}

// CASE js_multi_update_empty expect=fire
async function e3() {
	for (let i = 0, j = 1; i < 4; await save(i + j), i++);
}

// CASE js_empty_init_cond_empty expect=fire
async function e4() {
	let i = 0;
	for (; await more(i); i++);
}
